stock.description: Operating as an investment holding company, China Tianrui Group Cement Company Limited is engaged in the manufacturing, distribution, and sale of construction materials such as clinker, cement, and limestone aggregates across the People's Republic of China. Its primary customers include real estate developers and concrete manufacturers. The company was founded in 2000 and its main office is located in Ruzhou, PRC. China Tianrui Group Cement Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Yu Kuo Company Limited.
